messages.message: Youth section
Enable youth teams. Users can scout youth players and sign them for the senior team.
Users can scout for new talents.
Users can publish and accept match requests.
Salary per strength point
Player salary per match and per strength point.
Minimum age for senior team
Break between scouting sessions
in hours; the number of hours that must pass after scouting before another scouting session is allowed. 0 means no break.
Professional contract matches
Number of contract matches when a youth player is signed for the senior team.
Senior strength: technique
%; when a youth player is signed for the senior team.
Senior strength: stamina
Senior strength: fitness
Professional strength: Satisfaction
Scouting: Probability of success
as a percentage; How likely it is that a scout finds any player (regardless of strength).
Scouting: Minimum player strength
as a percentage; The minimum strength a found player may have.
Scouting: Maximum player strength
as a percentage; The maximum strength a found player may have.
Scouting: Standard deviation
as a percentage; How much the actual player strength may randomly deviate from the precisely calculated strength. 0 for no deviation.
Scouting: Minimum age
Match requests: Maximum per team
How many open match requests a team may have at the same time.
Match requests: Days in advance
How many days in advance a request can be placed.
Match requests: Permitted times
comma-separated (e.g. '14:00,17:00'). Intended to prevent server overload when league matches are also running at the same time.
Match requests: Latest acceptance
in hours; How many hours before kick-off the request must be accepted. Participants should still have enough time to set their line-up.
Maximum permitted matches per team per day
Strength change: Very good performance
Change in player strength points for a rating of 1.3 or better.
Strength change: Good performance
Change in player strength points for a rating between 1.4 and 2.3.
Strength change: Poor performance
Change in player strength points for a rating between 4.3 and 5.
Strength change: Very poor performance
Change in player strength points for a rating worse than 5.
Maximum youth player age
Youth players are deleted from this age onwards.
Maximum CPU youth players on the transfer list
Maximum number of youth players listed at the same time per CPU club.
Duration of CPU youth listings
Calendar days until a CPU listing is automatically decided or removed.
Maximum CPU offers per youth player
Maximum number of CPU offers open at the same time for each listed youth player.
Review time for youth offers
Hours until open CPU offers are evaluated at the latest, unless the offer limit is reached earlier.
Active CPU youth purchases below squad size
Targeted CPU youth purchases up to squad size
CPU youth sales above squad size
Maximum CPU players on the youth market
